notes: Bold retro brush script 'Cakelicious' with cream-yellow faces and red returns, plus a red offset 'shadow' layer behind (down and right), flat-cut and unlit, on a salmon-pink fascia band under a white crown cornice; white Tuscan columns frame the glass front, pink interior. Too soft to trace (letters ~30 px in the sheet tiles), so set in Pacifico at 1.12 width, which matches the looped k/l, the round o/u and the upswept final s; the 'C' is out of frame in the square-on view and is Pacifico's. x-height ~0.21 m from the ~1 m pink band.
